svg.aria-label: The reading from 11:15 to 13:00 against the gap from 70,000 to 74,000 lux, crossing 74,000 5 times, at 11:42, 11:50, 12:06, 12:21, and 12:53, and falling no lower than 70,495 lux after 11:42. Without a gap, the sensor is on from 11:42 to 11:50, from 12:06 to 12:21, and from 12:53 to 13:00, switching 5 times. With a gap, the sensor is on from 11:42 to 13:00, switching once
